card.name: Scattered mixed words, no shared theme
card.fires_on: No single word type. It fires on scattered words such as a character name, 'with', 'Topics', 'animal' or a colon after 'patients with', in children's book blurbs, web page footers and drug label lists.

modes.label: Children's book blurbs
modes.description: A noun or linking word inside a short description of a picture book.
